exposure: emigration from the former Soviet Union
Women who were <28 weeks gestation at the time of completing the first questionnaire
outcome: Actual mode of birth (emergency caesarean section, instrumental birth)
cohort: 836 parous women recruited at women's health centres and natural birth communities in Israel
finding: Women's attitudes towards the medicalization of childbirth were associated with their planned birth choices and predicted emergency caesarean sections and instrumental births.
mod_finding: More favourable attitudes towards medicalization of childbirth were associated with more medical modes of birth, both planned and unplanned.
